limits: No live deployment, provider request, employer submission, calendar integration, or external network call performed.
No browser download, spreadsheet save/reopen, or calendar import performed; automated formats and actual extracted handlers tested.
Calendar is a user-imported all-day file. No sync or alert guarantee. Same URL/date gives the same UID; changed date gives a new UID and does not delete an earlier imported event.
CSV is a human-viewing export with visible Text: prefix for formula-like fields. It is not a universal spreadsheet save/reopen defense. JSON preserves unmodified stored text.
CSV contains current saved application records and notes, not bookmarks without records, profile/CV/session fields, older account scopes or quarantine.
ICS includes saved job title, employer, public job link and follow-up day; it does not select profile email, private notes, account IDs, provider tokens, attendees or alarm fields.
Root integration/full hosted suite/remote CI and physical device acceptance are separate gates.
